name: Under Contract
intro: Selling whatever you happen to carry is fine. Selling what I need is better. I post contracts on my board - so many packs of a kind, by a deadline, with a bonus in seals. Take one and fill it.

steps.text: Take a trade contract at a trading post and fill it

outro: That's how the big traders do it: they know what's wanted before they pack it. Check the boards here and at Gullrock.
